controles.affirmation: Cyberattaque du 7 mai 2026 qualifiee de "material", donnees exfiltrees, systemes chiffres, impact financier non determine
controles.verbatim_source: "On May 7, 2026, West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. determined that the Company has experienced a material cybersecurity attack, in which certain data was exfiltrated by an unauthorized party and certain systems were encrypted" ; "The incident's material impact on the Company's financial condition and results of operations, if any, has not been determined at the time of filing." (8-K 11 mai 2026, Item 1.05)

controles.affirmation: Action de groupe New England Teamsters deposee le 5 mai 2025 devant un tribunal federal, plainte amendee le 15 octobre 2025, violations des sections 10(b), 20(a) et 20A, opposition des demandeurs le 24 fevrier 2026 et replique des defendeurs le 31 mars 2026
controles.verbatim_source: "On May 5, 2025, New England Teamsters Pension Fund filed a class action against us and certain of our current and former officers in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania ... The amended complaint alleges violations of Sections 10(b), 20(a) and 20A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 10b-5 ... the lead plaintiffs' opposition to the motion to dismiss was filed on February 24, 2026, and the defendants filed their reply on March 31, 2026." (10-Q T2 2026, note 16)

controles.affirmation: Eric Green a informe le conseil le 6 mars 2026 de son intention de partir ; Michel Lagarde, venu de Thermo Fisher, prend ses fonctions le 31 aout 2026
controles.verbatim_source: "Mr. Eric M. Green ... informed the Board on March 6, 2026 of his intent to retire" ; "On June 1, 2026, the Company announced the appointment of Michel Lagarde as President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, effective August 31, 2026" (8-K 1er juin 2026)

controles.affirmation: Le nouveau PDG negocie "un salaire de base de 1,175 M$ et une prime cible de 125% du salaire (soit 1,47 M$), plus des attributions long terme dont le montant n'est pas encore fixe"
controles.verbatim_source: "Mr. Lagarde will be granted 2026 LTI awards in this mix on the first business day of the first week following the Start Date with a total grant value of $8,611,111 (which represents a $10,000,000 target total grant value prorated for 2026)" ; "Mr. Lagarde will receive one-time inducement equity awards ... with a maximum aggregate grant value of $10,000,000" dont un "Sign-on Grant" de $6,875,000 (8-K 1er juin 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Le montant des attributions long terme EST fixe et publie : 8 611 111 $ de LTI 2026 (cible annuelle 10 M$ proratisee) plus des attributions d'embauche plafonnees a 10 M$. Reecrire : "salaire de base 1,175 M$, prime cible 1,47 M$, LTI 2026 de 8,6 M$ et attributions d'embauche jusqu'a 10 M$, soit un package de premiere annee superieur a 20 M$".

controles.affirmation: Marge brute West Vantage 14,2% au T2 2026 (-3,3 pt) contre 42,6% pour Produits Proprietaires (+2,5 pt), ecart d'environ 28 points
Le segment West Vantage "reste structurellement en dessous des niveaux atteints en 2020-2023 (14-20%)"
controles.verbatim_source: Serie CMP_gm (kpis-haut/WST.json) 2020-2023 : min 14,0% (Q1-2019/2020), max 20,1% (Q1-2022). La valeur T2 2026 de 14,2% se situe DANS cette fourchette, au plancher
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "la marge du segment est retombee au plancher de sa fourchette historique 2020-2023 (14-20%)" plutot que "en dessous".

controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Proprietary Products $ 2,492.1 ... Contract-Manufactured Products 582.0 ... Consolidated net sales $ 3,074.1" (582,0 / 3 074,1 = 18,93%)

controles.affirmation: Dependance a l'injectable menacee par les GLP-1 oraux (verbatim 10-K)
controles.verbatim_source: "Our business depends to a substantial extent on customers' continued sales and development of products that are delivered by injection, such as GLP-1s. If (i) our customers fail to continue to sell, develop and deploy injectable products and opt for products delivered via alternative means, such as oral GLP-1s ... our sales and profitability may suffer." (10-K FY2025)
